verse.verse_2: There is not, for its occurrence, Kadhibah.
verse.verse_4: When the earth will be shaken with a terrible shake.
verse.verse_5: And the mountains will be powdered to dust,
verse.verse_6: So that they will become floating dust particles.
verse.verse_7: And you (all) will be in three groups.
verse.verse_8: So those on the right -- how (fortunate) will be those on the right!
verse.verse_9: And those on the left -- how (unfortunate) will be those on the left!
verse.verse_10: And those foremost will be foremost.
verse.verse_11: These will be the nearest (to Allah).
verse.verse_13: A multitude of those will be from the first ones.
verse.verse_14: And a few of those will be from the later ones.
verse.verse_17: Immortal boys will go around them (serving),
verse.verse_18: With cups, and jugs, and a glass of flowing wine,
verse.verse_20: And with fruit that they may choose.
verse.verse_21: And with the flesh of fowls that they desire.
verse.verse_22: And (there will be) Hur with wide lovely eyes.
verse.verse_24: A reward for what they used to do.
verse.verse_25: No Laghw (evil vain talk) will they hear therein, nor any sinful speech.
verse.verse_26: But only the saying of: "Salaman! Salaman!"
verse.verse_27: And those on the right -- how (fortunate) will be those on the right
verse.verse_33: Whose supply is not cut off nor are they out of reach.
verse.verse_35: Verily, We have created them a special creation.
verse.verse_39: A multitude of those will be from the first generation.
verse.verse_40: And a multitude of those will be from the later generations.
verse.verse_41: And those on the left How will be those on the left
verse.verse_45: Verily, before that, they indulged in luxury,
verse.verse_46: And were persisting in great sin.
verse.verse_47: And they used to say: "When we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be resurrected"
verse.verse_49: Say: "(Yes) verily, those of old, and those of later times."
verse.verse_50: "All will surely be gathered together for appointed meeting of a known Day."
verse.verse_51: "Then verily, --- you the erring -- ones, the deniers!"
verse.verse_52: "You verily, will eat of the trees of Zaqqum."
verse.verse_53: "Then you will fill your bellies therewith,"
verse.verse_54: "And drink the Hamim on top of it."
verse.verse_56: That will be their entertainment on the Day of Recompense!
verse.verse_57: We created you, then why do you believe not
verse.verse_58: Do you not see the semen you emit.
verse.verse_59: Is it you who create it, or are We the Creator
verse.verse_60: We have decreed death to you all, and We are not outstripped,
verse.verse_61: To transfigure you and create you in (forms) that you know not.
verse.verse_62: And indeed, you have already known the first form of creation, why then do you not remember
verse.verse_63: Do you not see what you sow.
verse.verse_64: Is it you that make it grow, or are We the Grower
verse.verse_65: Were it Our will, We could crumble it to dry pieces, and you would be Tafakkahun.
verse.verse_68: Do you not see the water that you drink.
verse.verse_69: Is it you who cause it to come down from Al-Muzn, or are We the Cause of it coming down
verse.verse_70: If We willed, We verily could make it salty; why then do you not give thanks
verse.verse_71: Do you not see the fire which you kindle.
verse.verse_72: Is it you who made the tree thereof to grow, or are We the Grower
verse.verse_73: We have made it a Reminder, and an article of use for the Muqwin.
verse.verse_74: Then glorify with praises the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.
verse.verse_75: Fala! I swear by the Mawaqi` of the stars.
verse.verse_76: And verily that is indeed a great oath, if you but know.
verse.verse_77: That (this) is indeed an honorable recitation.
verse.verse_79: Which none touches but the pure ones.
verse.verse_80: A revelation from the Lord of all that exists.
verse.verse_81: Is it such a talk that you are Mudhinun
verse.verse_82: And you make your provision your denial!
verse.verse_83: Then why do you not (intervene) when it reaches Al-Hulqum
verse.verse_84: And you at the moment are looking,
verse.verse_85: But We are nearer to him than you, but you see not,
verse.verse_86: Then why do you not -- if you are not Madinin
verse.verse_87: Return the soul, if you are truthful
verse.verse_88: Then, if he be of the Muqarrabin,
verse.verse_89: Then Rawh, Rayhan and a Garden of Delights.
verse.verse_90: And if he be of those on the right,
verse.verse_91: Then Salam (peace) to you from those on the right.
verse.verse_92: But if he be of the denying, the erring,
verse.verse_93: Then for him is an entertainment with Hamim.
verse.verse_95: Verily, this! This is an absolute truth with certainty.
verse.verse_96: So, glorify with praises the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.
